_comment: What the boutique's catalogue PDFs actually say. The PDFs carry no text layer -- every product name and price is drawn into the photograph itself -- so these were read by eye from the pictures and written down here. Each entry can be checked against source/extracted/<file>. 'caption' and 'price' are transcriptions, quoted exactly as printed including the boutique's own spelling; nothing here is inferred, corrected or filled in. sha1 ties a transcription to the exact image it was read from, so a changed picture is caught instead of silently inheriting the old words.

Anklets_p1.caption: Anklets
Anklets_p1.shows: Gold anklet worn on a dark display foot: rhinestone-set section on one side, a gold bow at the centre front, swirl-link chain running to the other side.
Anklets_p1.matchedOn: name 'Anklets' and price 280 both agree with the catalogue entry 'Anklet' at Rs 280

Anklets_p2.caption: Antitarnish anklet
Anklets_p2.shows: Fine gold anklet on a white foot form against black: thin chain with small gold beads and a drop at the end.
Anklets_p2.matchedOn: name 'Antitarnish anklet' and price 280 both agree with the catalogue entry 'Anti-tarnish anklet' at Rs 280

armcuff_p1.caption: Nature inspired butterfly armcuff
armcuff_p1.shows: Gold armcuff worn on an upper arm: two filigree butterflies on a fine open coil.
armcuff_p1.matchedOn: 'butterfly armcuff' and price 280 both agree with the catalogue entry 'Butterfly armcuff' at Rs 280

armcuff_p2.caption: Sculpted double floral open armcuff
armcuff_p2.shows: Gold armcuff worn on an upper arm: two sculpted daisy flowers on an open double band.
armcuff_p2.matchedOn: caption matches the catalogue name 'Sculpted double floral open armcuff' word for word, price 280 agrees

bracelet_p1.caption: Evileye charm bracelet
bracelet_p1.shows: Gold bangle-style bracelet in a presentation box, with evil-eye charms, a pave bead, gold beads and a blue teardrop stone.
bracelet_p1.matchedOn: 'Evileye charm bracelet' and price 350 both agree with the catalogue entry 'Evil eye charm bracelet' at Rs 350

Black_clover_set_p1.caption: Black clover set
Black_clover_set_p1.shows: Gold and black four-leaf-clover parure on satin: necklace, bracelet, ring and a pair of studs, all with black clover motifs.
Black_clover_set_p1.matchedOn: caption matches the catalogue name 'Black clover set' word for word, price 499 agrees

Cloth_section_western_wear_p1.caption: Round neck polyster kafthan with inner
Cloth_section_western_wear_p1.shows: Two garments side by side on hangers: a plain fuchsia sleeveless inner with matching shorts, and the kaftan itself in a coral, pink and orange abstract print with gold embroidery at the neckline.
Cloth_section_western_wear_p1.matchedOn: caption matches the catalogue name (site spells it 'Round-neck polyester kaftan with inner'), price 1280 agrees
Cloth_section_western_wear_p1.note: One photograph containing both pieces of the one product -- the inner and the kaftan. Not two products.

Cloth_section_western_wear_p2.caption: Cotton embroidery with elastic hand cordset
Cloth_section_western_wear_p2.shows: Brown cotton co-ord with cream and brown floral cutwork embroidery along the hems: left half worn by a model outdoors, right half the top and wide trousers on hangers.
Cloth_section_western_wear_p2.matchedOn: caption matches the catalogue name 'Cotton embroidery elastic-hand cordset', price 1352 agrees
Cloth_section_western_wear_p2.note: One photograph holding two genuine views of the same co-ord -- worn, and flat on hangers.

Cloth_section_western_wear_p3.caption: Plazo cordset with inner lining
Cloth_section_western_wear_p3.shows: Charcoal/black co-ord worn by a model beside a blue car: V-neck three-quarter-sleeve top with gold-outlined floral embroidery down the front, matching palazzo trousers.
Cloth_section_western_wear_p3.matchedOn: caption matches the catalogue name 'Palazzo cordset with inner lining', price 950 agrees

Cloth_section_western_wear_p4.caption: Western wear
Cloth_section_western_wear_p4.shows: Indigo asymmetric tunic with red and cream geometric embroidery down the front, tassels at the hem, worn with wide indigo palazzo trousers -- shown both on a model and on a hanger.
Cloth_section_western_wear_p4.reason: No price is printed on this page and the caption is only the category, 'Western wear'. There is no matching product in the catalogue. Rule: no confirmed price, no live product -- do not create one and do not attach these images to any other piece.
